mn9:2.2: para. 2. saddhamma, the word, traced as a ger. of sant + dahati (or dharati). It can be taken as an emphatic ?? … … … . ??[^1] of dhamma, in which case it is renderable as the True Dhamma; or it can be taken as a ger. from saddahati (‘to have faith’) from which the noun saddhā (‘faith’) comes, in which case it is renderable by ‘(true) object of faith’ or ‘what faith should be placed in (rightly)’.
